title: Held-out: pilot savings came from the most favourable site
purpose: Present the route-planning pilot results to the operations board
objectives: Get approval to extend the pilot to three more depots

brief.text: Pilot ran at one depot for eight weeks. Headline result: fuel cost down 14%. Approval needed for three more depots.

turns.text: In the pilot, fuel cost at the depot fell fourteen percent over eight weeks.
That's a strong number. Which depot was it?
Northgate is the one with the new orbital road, isn't it? Its routes changed a lot this spring anyway.
The three depots you want next are all city-centre sites with fixed delivery windows.

mustInclude: Engages with whether the 14% came from the planner or from Northgate's road change, or whether it transfers to city-centre depots with fixed windows
Is a single question the user can ask or answer now
mustNotInclude: Repeats the 14% result as settled proof for the other depots
Re-asks which depot ran the pilot
checkpoints.ideal: Raise the board's real concern directly: ask which part of the 14% they would need to see separated from the orbital road effect, or propose comparing against another depot over the same weeks.

sources.title: Pilot summary
sources.text: Route planner pilot, Northgate depot, 8 weeks. Fuel cost per stop: -14% vs the previous 8 weeks. No control depot was used.
